## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 374 captures during May 2019. The activity represents the completed imaging workload reported for the site during the month. Capture sessions proceeded as planned, with no operational issues reported beyond routine leave arrangements. The available activity record provides the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading performance.

## Image quality

Of the captured examinations, 20 were marked ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 5.3. The finding indicates that most images were suitable for assessment, while the ungradable examinations should continue to inform local review of capture technique, patient preparation, and any recurring equipment or workflow issues. The result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for the site.

## Grading

Grading identified 50 referable results. The median lag from image capture to completion of grading was 5 days. This provides an indication of the typical reporting interval during May 2019, while individual cases may have taken longer or less time to process. Overall, the report records the site’s activity, image quality, and grading outcomes for the period, with routine leave the only exception noted in session planning.
